Very simple toy model: `y ~ N(mu, sigma)`. 


```{r}
# data 
df <- as_tibble(rnorm(100, 5, 3))
# formula 
f <- bf(value ~ 1)
make_stancode(f, data = df)
```

# Prior Predictive Checks 

- source: https://mc-stan.org/docs/stan-users-guide/posterior-predictive-checks.html#prior-predictive-checks 

Let's assume `mu ~ N(4, 2)` and `sigma ~ N(3, 1)`: 

```{r}
# Define the data 
N <- 100
my_x <- rnorm(N, 0, 1)

stan_data <- list(
  N = N, 
  x = my_x
)

model <- cmdstan_model("ex1.stan")
```

Fit the stan model: 

```{r}
fit1 <- model$sample(
  data = stan_data, 
  chains = 4, 
  fixed_param = TRUE, 
  iter_warmup = 0, 
  iter_sampling = 1000, 
  refresh = 0
)
```

```{r}
fit1$draws("y_sim") %>% as_draws_df(.) %>% 
  select(1) # %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = `y_sim[1]`)) # + 
  geom_slab()
```
